decisions.reason: The source changes the relationship between labels, initial field instructions, and hover help; it does not change the Danish language or the specified date and subject placeholder text.
Persistent labels and hover help do not necessarily alter the existing robustness, legacy-field, or editable-text architecture requirements.
The source explains how original field purpose remains recoverable after text replacement but does not change the existing requirement to clear placeholder text upon field activation.
The label and hover-help decision does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.
Adding persistent labels and hover help neither replaces nor resolves the separate requirement and ambiguity concerning grey editable-field cues.
The source does not change the calendar-dropdown method used for date entry.
The source changes field-label and help behavior, not the checklist-and-dropdown control configuration.
Field labels and hover help are unrelated to creating manual line breaks after legacy-content pasting.
The source does not affect pasted-table stability or right-hand column containment.
The source concerns interactive-field labels, not image and table caption labels or their typography and style name.
The field-label and hover-help decision does not change legacy-content paste behavior, test files, stability constraints, or the unresolved paste workflow.
The source does not change whether required theme colors must be included.
